title: IDP Feature Manifest
description: feature.yaml — the declaration every installable IDP feature ships with.

featureId.description: Unique slug for the feature (DNS-safe). Used as S3 prefix and session-tag value.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI nav and feature page.

docsUrl.description: OSS features: a docs-site slug (e.g. 'extensions/sample-document-status') resolved against the published docs site for the UI 'Learn more' link. May also be an absolute https URL. Marketplace features omit this and fall back to marketplaceListingUrl.

path.description: Path to the feature's CloudFormation template, relative to the project root.

requiresMainStackName.description: If true, the template must declare a MainStackName parameter.

bundlePath.description: Path (relative to project root) to the built UMD bundle (ui-bundle.js).

buildCommand.description: Command run from project root to (re)build the bundle. Optional — if omitted, the bundle is expected to already exist.

productCode.description: AWS Marketplace product code. When set, the main-stack FeatureProductCodeMap must include this entry for entitlements to resolve.

listingUrl.description: Public Marketplace listing URL shown in the NONE/EXPIRED UI states.

defaultParameters.description: CloudFormation parameters pre-filled on the Launch Stack URL. Values must be scalar.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the feature declares. Displayed on the FeaturePage as chips.

path.description: Path (relative to project root) to a YAML/JSON config preset uploaded to the feature bucket and applied to the host's ConfigurationTable at install time.

configPreset.description: Vertical-product packs (e.g. claims-pack) ship a config preset that becomes a new Config version in the host on install.

pipelineHooks.description: Map of pipeline hook point -> CloudFormation logical Lambda resource name in this template. The feature stack registers the resolved ARNs with the host via registerFeatureHooks at install time.

packageCommand.description: Shell command (run from project root) to package the agent source zip.

artifactPath.description: Path (relative to project root) to the packaged agent-source.zip.

agentSource.description: Optional agent source packaging config. When present, the publisher runs packageCommand and uploads the resulting zip.

wrapperTemplatePath.description: Path (relative to project root) to the single-template deployment wrapper (deploy.yaml). publish-pack bakes the published artifact URLs into this template's parameter defaults and uploads the result.

hostTemplateUrlParam.description: Name of the wrapper parameter that takes the host accelerator template URL.

artifactSourceParam.description: Name of the wrapper parameter that takes the public artifact source URL prefix. Defaults to '<FeatureIdCamel>ArtifactSource'.

versionParam.description: Name of the wrapper parameter that takes the feature version. Defaults to '<FeatureIdCamel>Version'.

pack.description: Optional vertical-product pack config. When present, `idp-feature-cli publish-pack` produces a single-template deployment wrapper with all artifact URLs baked in as defaults, and `idp-feature-cli deploy-pack` deploys it with minimal arguments.
